subject: Amberlane: Entity restructure — split remittance & portal admin change
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@amberlane.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Amberlane restructuring — remittance split request

Hi Neha,

Hope you're well. Quick heads up from Amberlane: we closed a small subsidiary reorganization last week and will be routing some AP flows to the new entity starting next month. This is internal restructuring only — POs and SOWs remain with Amberlane Solutions — but we need Redwood to pay a portion of invoices to a secondary bank account for Amberlane Logistics (our logistics arm).

Requested change:
- Primary remit (70% of net) -> Amberlane Solutions (existing account).
- Secondary remit (30% of net) -> Amberlane Logistics (new bank account).
- Effective for invoices dated on/after Aug 1, 2026.

I've attached a current W-9 and the bank letter confirming the new account. We can provide a board resolution if required. Can you confirm what you need from us to update the vendor record and split payments at invoice time? Also note that Sofia Ramos will be the new portal admin and should be added to the supplier portal.

Attachments: Amberlane_W9.pdf, Amberlane_BankLetter_20260710.pdf

Thanks —
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance, Amberlane Solutions
liam.oconnor@amberlane.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@amberlane.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Amberlane restructuring — remittance split request

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the attachments. Copying Karthik from Payments and Marissa from Onboarding so we can coordinate the updates.

A few quick asks so we can move this through AP and the procurement system:
1) Legal name on invoicing: please confirm exact legal entity names to appear on invoices for both allocations (primary and secondary).
2) Confirmation that existing purchase orders remain under "Amberlane Solutions" (no PO reissuance).
3) Please upload a signed board resolution or an internal authorization (on letterhead) that explicitly allows split remittance and names Sofia Ramos as portal admin.
4) We need a completed vendor update form (I attached vendor_update_form.pdf) and a bank letter on bank letterhead showing account number, routing, and account holder name for Amberlane Logistics.

Once we have those items, Karthik will set up the secondary remit account in the ERP and create a payment allocation rule so AP can auto-split invoices (70/30) at payment time. Marissa will handle adding Sofia to the portal and updating the portal admin contact.

If you prefer, we can run a short call to walk through the DocuSign/portal steps — otherwise send the docs and we'll start processing.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@amberlane.com>

Date: 2026-07-13T08:24:00-07:00

Legal names for invoicing:
- Primary (70%): Amberlane Solutions, Inc. — EIN: 12-3456789
- Secondary (30%): Amberlane Logistics, LLC — EIN: 98-7654321

Bank details for Amberlane Logistics (secondary remit) — (bank letter attached):
- Bank: WestBay National Bank
- Account name: Amberlane Logistics, LLC
- Account number: ****5678
- Routing: 111000025
- Allow ACH and wire.

Allocation rule: we request Redwood apply a 70/30 net allocation (pre-tax) on all invoices submitted under current POs. If your system requires invoice lines to be split, we can add an allocation memo on our invoices to make the split explicit.

Portal admin: add Sofia Ramos (sofia.ramos@amberlane.com) as the supplier portal admin — she will manage invoice uploads and 1099 contacts.

DocuSign: I've included a DocuSign link for the board resolution and authorization form in case you prefer signed workflow: https://docsend.com/view/amberlane-evidence

Best,
Liam
